caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug with a rounded body, narrow neck, and a small handle attached from the neck to the upper shoulder. The jug is primarily beige or tan in color with visible tonal variations, giving a sense of texture and depth. The surface is adorned with blue floral and leafy patterns painted on the front and side, featuring distinct blue leaves, stems, and abstract floral shapes. There are also blue decorative marks along the rim of the neck. The jug is shown in a three-quarter view, revealing the curved contour and depth of the object. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, simplified sketch or inset image of the same jug, also showing the blue floral design, within a rectangular frame. Both the main image and the inset are bordered by rectangular outlines, and the background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
